question: One of the following drugs is NOT used in the treatment of chronic hepatitis B:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Entecavir -> inhibits hepatitis B virus replication -> used in the treatment of chronic hepatitis B -> 100% CHAIN: Adefovir -> inhibits hepatitis B virus replication -> used in the treatment of chronic hepatitis B -> 100% CHAIN: Tenofovir -> inhibits hepatitis B virus replication -> used in the treatment of chronic hepatitis B -> 100% CHAIN: Sofosbuvir -> used in the treatment of chronic hepatitis C, not hepatitis B -> NOT used in the treatment of chronic hepatitis B -> 100%
analysis: Sofosbuvir is NOT used in the treatment of chronic hepatitis B. It is primarily used in the treatment of chronic hepatitis C.
